description: This PHP class defines a validation component for percentage values in CSS attributes, specifically within the HTMLPurifier library. It validates strings to ensure they represent valid percentage values according to CSS specifications, leveraging a number validation component.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Percentage
classes.description: A class to validate CSS percentage values, ensuring correct formatting and numerical validity, including optional non-negativity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the number validation component, optionally enforcing non-negative values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a string as a percentage value, checking proper format, presence of '%' at the end, and numerical correctness via the number_def component.
